T-FEATURE.note: T-FEATURE template: concept B 'The Guided Path' picked by Mikko (operator) 2026-08-15. This is the WORKHORSE type: 20 of the 46 non-home pages inherit it, the largest single inheritance in the build. Verified at 110317 B. Decisive factor beyond composition: B is the ONLY concept in this tournament carrying ZERO page-local CSS. Measured this session, every other concept defines classes in a <style> block that promote-concept.mjs never carries (it extracts only the <main> body, and every concept's <style> sits before <main>); stripping that block changes EVERY section on EVERY concept tested, up to -38% page height on T-FEATURE/a. B therefore builds exactly as previewed, with zero migration risk, on the template with the widest blast radius. Composition: the locked sheet makes position:sticky inert (.section sets overflow:hidden), so B substitutes three STRUCTURAL devices for the usual pinned rail, an in-flow nine-row route index with anchors that works with scripting off, an ordinal stamped on every band, and a ruled hand-off foot naming the next stage. 3792 visible words across 106 paragraphs and 10 h2s, the most substantial copy of the three. 11 sections, 11 heavy-rigor ledgers, 5 first-party images, 0 generated. Its agent cited _SCROLL-STICKY-BEHAVIOR-LIBRARY as consulted AND DEDUCTED FROM, which is the honest citation: the pinned rail is unusable here and the three devices are its structural substitute. VERIFICATION, honestly scoped: 6 static gates PASS with a falsifier proving each live (dom-structure, cta-singularity, no-dashes, selection-rationale, section-height-sane, no-unfilled-slots); 6 remain NOT-JUDGED because they are inert or silent even at the correct pages/<page>.content.html path and are NOT claimed as passes; all 5 CLI render gates PASS plus design-system-used. B-1 FIXED before stamping: the concept carried 2 peso figures and ZERO instances of the literal REPRESENTATIVE-PLACEHOLDER token the rule requires within 80 chars. Both now carry it in VISIBLE content, deliberately not in a comment, because the block-banned-content patch applied this session strips comments and a comment-borne token would game the very rule it was fixing. banned-content now PASS (2 figures / 2 tokens).

T-COMPANY.note: T-COMPANY template: concept A confirmed by Mikko (operator) 2026-08-15. Single-concept type (1 page: about); a confirmation, not a tournament. Verified at 91993 B: 6 static gates PASS with a falsifier proving each live, 0 FAIL, 6 NOT-JUDGED (inert/silent at the correct path, NOT claimed as passes); all 5 CLI render gates PASS; design-system-used PASS; block-banned-content PASS (its 10 '#1' occurrences are menu citations inside selection-ledger comments, which the comment-stripping patch correctly no longer reads as ranking claims). GATE CONFLICT RESOLVED BEFORE STAMPING, owner-approved: this page was the only artifact failing verify-not-flat, on heuristic (e) NO-DARK-RHYTHM, which demands >= 2 dark-surface sections BEYOND the closing CTA for any slug matching MARQUEE_SLUG_RE. That directly contradicted the client's MEASURED identity. C7 _handoff/visual-direction.md records BRAND-SIGNATURE dark_ratio 0 with 'This brand does not do dark heroes ... a dark treatment would be a tone inversion, not an upgrade'; the FEEL lock declares 'Dark budget: 1 of 3 bands, spent once'; the locked chrome states its .precta 'is also the page's ONE dark punctuation'. Measured: ALL 8 winning artifacts carry 0 dark sections in <main> and 4 in the chrome, exactly as the contract requires, and 3 of 47 pages (index, results, about) match the marquee regex and would have been blocked for honouring their own brand. Adding dark bands was rejected as the wrong fix: it would violate C7 and invert the tone on the three highest-traffic pages. Instead verify-not-flat now yields heuristic (e) ONLY when the build's own C7 declares a near-zero dark_ratio, reading the machine-readable BRAND-SIGNATURE comment; the threshold is 0.05 and the reader returns null (heuristic unchanged, fail-closed) on any missing handoff, missing signature, non-numeric field, UTF-16 file or parse error. Proven 6/6 both directions: waived at dark_ratio 0; STILL BLOCKS with the declaration removed, at 0.6 and at 0.2; heuristic (c) NO-IMAGERY still fires with the waiver active; a non-marquee slug is unaffected. An earlier version of this patch used '<= 1' and wrongly waived 0.6, conflating an area ratio with a band count; the both-directions proof caught it. The gate's own smoke passes and its no-handoff 'freeball' fixture still fires (e), confirming fail-closed. C7 was edited and restored byte-identical during the proof, and G-SEAM re-verified exit 0.
